game_updates.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 10/08/2026
game_updates.contents: First week of EA Javelin AnticheatSince the transition to EA Javelin Anticheat, we’ve continued to monitor, identify, and disrupt cheating across Apex Legends. The move to Javelin gives our Anti-Cheat team greater visibility into threats and more flexibility to respond as new cheats emerge.We wanted to share an update on what we’ve seen since the transition, including the volume of cheat attempts prevented, enforcement actions taken, and the types of cheating we’ve disrupted. Before diving into the numbers, we should discuss cheat prevention. In the first week following the launch of Javelin Anti-Cheat, 265,550 cheating attempts have been prevented before they could impact gameplay.This is an important distinction when looking at anti-cheat numbers. Javelin is designed not only to identify...

game_updates.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - 1.62 Update: New Garages
game_updates.contents: Today, we bring you news from the upcoming 1.62 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2. As part of this update, we will be introducing new truck garage models across the map! We already gave the truck garages in American Truck Simulator a refresh with the 1.58 update, and now it is time to give them the same treatment in Euro Truck Simulator 2. As you know, we are gradually reworking older areas of the base map, with the Benelux rework being the latest addition, while the rework for United Kingdom is currently underway. game_updates.title: Turn your build into an adventure with Sparkworks!
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Flameborn! We're very proud to be introducing Sparkworks, Enshrouded's brand new logic system, coming to the game with 1.0! What's a logic system? It's a way to connect inputs, like pulling a lever, stepping on a pressure plate, etc, with an output, such as a door opens, a trap opens underfoot... The sky's the limit, the world is your oyster, the metaphors are running out. So just watch the cool video we made to introduce Sparkworks. Hope you like it! That's it for Sparkworks and for us today. We hope you're excited and if you are not, just think what would happen if you replaced the bridge in your base by trapdoors activated when stepping on the bridge, and just didn't tell your friends... game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 10/6/2026
game_updates.contents: TESTING:Starting tomorrow, October 7th at approximately 10am PT, we will be conducting a matchmaking test by enabling cross-play as the default option for all players, on all platforms in the US-West servers. The intention of this test is to shorten queue times and tighten matchmaking skill bands. This test will run until the season ends on November 3rd. Console players can opt out of the test by turning off cross-play in your settings menu.FIXED: Fixed an issue with missing floor geo on Broken Moon in Terraformer; players are no longer able to clip into the ground.Fixed an issue with Gibraltar skydive emote audio persisting after landing.

game_updates.title: I apologize for my absence.
game_updates.contents: Hello everyone. I just wanted to make this post explaining the recent silence on our news feed... and also update all of you on the progress we've been making on our upcoming major update. As many of you all know, our development team is comprised of part-time and volunteer developers. The little money we make is split amongst ourselves and helps cover development-related costs, but our entire team primarily supports themselves through meaningful careers outside of the games industry. Operation: Harsh Doorstop has been built by medical technicians, construction workers, military service members, and all varieties of working-class individuals. We take pride in that, and it is one of the primary reasons our game has been able to indefinitely continue development when so many other projects f...
